title: Desenvolvedor de back end Node.js
description:
Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Node.js- Sênior.

Procuramos alguém com perfil colaborativo, boa comunicação e habilidade para se adaptar a diferentes desafios técnicos e organizacionais. Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Se você curte diversão, energia, alegria, desafios criativos e é uma pessoa organizada, resolutiva, detalhista e orientada a resultados, vem com a gente!

Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end em Node.js, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura e padrões de projeto.
  • Criar, documentar e integrar APIs RESTful de alta performance utilizando TypeScript e Express.
  • Projetar e otimizar modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL) e/ou NoSQL (MongoDB), garantindo queries performáticas e escalabilidade.
  • Utilizar ORMs como TypeORM, Sequelize ou Prisma para manipulação eficiente do banco de dados.
  • Versionar código com Git, adotando workflows (GitFlow, pull requests, code reviews) e boas práticas de controle de versão.
  • Trabalhar com Docker e docker-compose para criar ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção consistentes e reproduzíveis.
  • Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) usando Jest, Mocha ou similares.
  • Implementar mecanismos de cache (Redis, Memcached) e filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka) para melhorar performance e escalabilidade.
  • Monitorar e depurar aplicações em produção utilizando ferramentas como Node Profiler, Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus.
  • Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) para deploy automatizado em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou Kubernetes.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (front-end, DevOps, QA) em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando de planning, daily e retrospectivas.

Resquisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com Node.js e TypeScript, aplicando padrões de projeto (Factory, Repository, Dependency Injection) e estruturação modular (Clean Architecture, DDD).
  • Uso de Express (ou NestJS/Koa) para construção de APIs, dominando rotas, middlewares, tratamento de erros e validação de payload (class-validator, Joi, Celebrate).
  • Gerenciamento de pacotes com npm ou yarn, versionamento semântico (semver) e controle de dependências.
  • Testes Automatizados: domínio de frameworks como Jest ou Mocha + Chai, testes de integração (supertest) e uso de mocks/fakes.
  • Escalabilidade e Desempenho: experiência em cache (Redis), filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) e otimizações de consultas em bancos relacionais (índices, partições).
  • Performance e Debugging: uso de ferramentas como Node Profiler, Clinic.js, monitoramento com Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus/Grafana.
  • Integração Contínua e Deploy: prática com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) e deploy em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou ambientes Kubernetes.
  • Docker Avançado: criação de imagens otimizadas, multi-stage builds e configuração de docker-compose para desenvolvimento e produção.
  • Banco de Dados Relacional Avançado: MySQL ou PostgreSQL (índices, query profiling, replicação, particionamento).
  • APIs Performáticas e Seguras: experiência com GraphQL (Apollo Server), API Gateway, autenticação/autorização via OAuth2, JWT e versionamento de APIs.
  • Git Profundo: workflows GitFlow, rebase vs merge, cherry-pick e estratégias de branching para times grandes.

Habilidades:

  • Conhecimento em PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony): será considerado um diferencial entender boas práticas de desenvolvimento back-end em PHP e migrar/integrações pontuais.
  • Experiência com React (ou Next.js): habilidade para colaborar com o front-end em aplicações isomórficas ou SPA, integrando APIs e estados globais (Redux, Context API).
  • Frameworks Node.js avançados: NestJS (dependency injection, modules, providers), Koa ou Fastify para cenários de alta concorrência.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): conhecimento em Terraform ou CloudFormation para provisionamento de ambientes AWS.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: uso de ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Loki/Grafana, OpenTelemetry para logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: trabalho com Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SNS/SQS, WebSockets (Socket.io) e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Microservices: experiência em decomposição de sistemas monolíticos, deploy independente de serviços, comunicação via mensageria e API Gateway.
  • Segurança: implementação de práticas OWASP (mitigação de SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF), configuração de WAF (Cloudflare, AWS WAF) e auditoria de código.
  • Serverless: desenvolvimento e deploy de funções AWS Lambda em Node.js/TypeScript, integração com DynamoDB, S3 e triggers (SQS, API Gateway).

Benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição via cartão Ifood Benefícios.
  • Ajuda de custo ou vale transporte via Ifood Benefícios.
  • Assistência médica (coparticipativa, extensiva à dependentes)
  • Assistência odontológica (extensiva à dependentes)
  • Day off e mimo no aniversário.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Licença maternidade estendida.
  • Espaço interativo com videogame.
  • Espaço de descompressão #DESLIGUER.
  • Frutas todos os dias
  • Estacionamento.
  • Treinamentos constantes e oportunidades de desenvolvimento.

  • Local: 100% Presencial em Campinas/SP (Polo II de Alta Tecnologia CPQD)
  • Contratação CLT
  • Residir em Campinas/SP e região ou disponibilidade de mudança para Campinas.

title: Coordenador de Logística
description:
Sobre a Vaga:

O Coordenador de Logística é responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar a aquisição de bens e serviços relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos, garantindo qualidade, entrega pontual e eficiência de custos. Essa função exige sólidos conhecimentos técnicos em logística para avaliar especificações, negociar com fornecedores e alinhar as atividades de compras às necessidades operacionais e estratégicas.

Ele/Ela se reportará ao Diretor de Compras Sub-Regional e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as fábricas e os especialistas locais em Compras de Transporte, a fim de garantir a continuidade do fornecimento e a competitividade das licitações dos fornecedores.

Principais Atribuições:

  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos para operações logísticas (transporte, armazenagem, embalagem, equipamentos e materiais).
  • Realizar análises técnicas e comerciais de propostas para garantir a conformidade com as especificações e padrões de qualidade.
  • Negociar contratos e termos comerciais, visando otimizar o custo total e o prazo de entrega.
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho dos fornecedores (SLA, qualidade, pontualidade, custo), conduzir análises de negócios e estabelecer ações corretivas conforme necessário.
  • Colaborar com as equipes técnicas e operacionais para garantir que as compras atendam aos requisitos logísticos e de produção.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de compras que reduzam riscos e aumentem a eficiência da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Manter atualizado o banco de dados de fornecedores e o mapeamento de mercado.
  • Apoiar o processo orçamentário e as premissas de tendências de mercado.
  • Gerenciar os custos logísticos, incluindo planejados versus reais, por cliente/região e como percentual da receita.
  • Acompanhar a legislação.
  • Implementar as melhores práticas; colaborar com colegas para compartilhar conhecimento e aprendizado, impulsionando a melhoria contínua.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com operações/fábricas, fornecedores e consultores para otimizar gastos por meio de projetos técnicos.

title: Preschool Teaching Assistant (maternity cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW: 

The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.

Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.

ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:

Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.

Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.

Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.

Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Instructional Support and Student Learning

Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.

Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.

Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.

Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.

Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.

Student Care and Learning Environment

Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.

Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).

Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.

Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.

Operational and School Support

Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.

Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.

Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.

Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.

Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.

Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed. 

Professional Conduct and Growth

Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.

Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.

Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.

Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.

Additional Responsibilities

Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.

Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school. 

Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.

Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.

Working Conditions

Walk on paths and rough terrain

Lifting backpacks and school materials

Other duties, as assigned.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in Pedagogy, preferred
  • Five years experience working with children, preferred
  • PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred)
  • English level required: B2 or above
  • Portuguese level required: B2 or above

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
  • Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills
  • Strong professional organization skills

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.

Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!

Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.

We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).

Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Customer Support Manager LATAM
description:
The Internet of Things (IoT) is transforming our world—making it safer, more sustainable, and smarter. As a Quectel company, Acceleronix empowers customers to succeed in their IoT projects by turning innovative ideas into impactful, real-world solutions.

At Acceleronix, our customers' and employees' groundbreaking ideas drive everything we do. We take creative concepts from the drawing board to full production, delivering solutions that make a tangible difference.

Joining our team means collaborating with company leaders, and building strong relationships with colleagues who share your curiosity about connecting the unconnected. We're a team that cares deeply about our customers, values having fun, and is committed to making a positive impact in our local communities.

Role Overview

We’re seeking a proactive and experienced LATAM Customer Support Manager to build, lead, and scale our customer support function across Latin America. This role is based in Brazil Campinas and will be responsible for setting up the regional support team, defining workflows, and ensuring high service levels across technical support, commercial inquiries, and logistics coordination.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring someone who can operate strategically while actively engaging with customers and internal teams to solve challenges, improve operations, and ensure an exceptional customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Support Operations Build the LATAM Customer Support organization from the ground up, including hiring, onboarding, and mentoring support agents. Define and implement support workflows, escalation paths, and SLAs tailored to regional needs. Oversee support for technical issues, commercial inquiries, order tracking, and logistics coordination.

Knowledge Management Develop and maintain a robust knowledge base and internal documentation. Establish best practices for capturing, updating, and sharing critical customer-facing information.

Customer Engagement & Escalation Management Serve as the escalation point for key customers and complex support cases. Foster long-term customer relationships through effective communication and issue resolution.

Collaboration & Enablement Work closely with Sales, Operations, and Product teams to streamline support handoffs and improve customer journeys. Act as the voice of the customer to influence service improvements and product enhancements.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement Track KPIs and generate insights to drive process improvements. Establish reporting cadences for internal stakeholders and continuously evaluate performance metrics.

Qualifications

Experience 5+ years in a customer support or operations leadership role, ideally in an IoT environment, telco or B2B SAAS environments. Proven experience scaling support teams and building processes from scratch. Strong understanding of technical support, customer operations, and logistics in LATAM markets.

Skills

Exceptional problem-solving and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and follow-through. Comfortable with CRM and ticketing platforms (e.g., Freshdesk, Salesforce).

Mindset: Hands-on, entrepreneurial attitude with a passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences. Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-paced environments.

Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of IoT architectures, including connectivity options (e.g., NB-IoT, LTE-M), device management, and cloud platforms.

Voice of the Customer & Innovation: Catalyst Act as an internal champion for customer needs. Translate feedback into actionable insights to influence product innovation and roadmap direction.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with customers, the sales team, and internal stakeholders to support customers, leveraging both Acceleronix and third-party offerings.

Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences in Portuguese, Spanish, and English.

Customer-Centric Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals.

Location Based in Brazil, Campinas.

Schedule: This position requires flexibility to work in shifts and be on-call, including weekends and holidays, to support customers across different time zones. Availability for emergency escalations and regional coordination is essential. Candidates must be prepared to adjust working hours as needed to ensure consistent service coverage and issue resolution.

Travel: The role requires frequent travel, approximately 25% of the time, both within Brazil and internationally, including multi-week business trips as needed.

This is a role at the forefront of a fast-growing tech sector, offering high-impact exposure to IoT innovation, digital transformation, and global ecosystems. You’ll join a collaborative and innovative environment within a dynamic international team, with ample opportunities for professional growth, leadership, and advancement. In addition to shaping and scaling global customer success operations, you'll benefit from competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package.

Join us at Acceleronix and be a part of shaping the future of IoT.

title: Analista de Operações Pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Realizar o controle do faturamento do condomínio;
  • Realizar o rateio de despesas operacionais entre lojistas, garantindo a correta alocação dos custos por centro de custo;
  • Acompanhar manutenções preventivas e corretivas das áreas comuns do shopping, controlando cronogramas e performance de prestadores;

description:
Responsibilities

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in English communication, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, flexibility, and a proactive approach to continuous learning.

About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack
description:
Organização do setor cultural busca profissional com experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento Full-Stack, para atuar de forma presencial, com foco em React e Firebase.

O cargo tem como principal objetivo assegurar a evolução, manutenção e inovação dos sistemas web da instituição, garantindo qualidade, segurança e performance nas soluções desenvolvidas.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Manter e evoluir o sistema principal de gestão de cadastros, prêmios e estoque;
  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades Full-Stack, abrangendo frontend (React), backend (Cloud Functions) e banco de dados (Firestore);
  • Implantar integrações automáticas via API de WhatsApp e e-mails para novos usuários;
  • Otimizar e manter relatórios técnicos em Excel e PDF, com filtros e processamento no servidor;
  • Garantir a segurança e integridade dos dados, aplicando boas práticas de desenvolvimento e políticas de segurança em Cloud Functions;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de modernização tecnológica e automação de processos.

Requisitos Técnicos Imprescindíveis

  • Experiência avançada com React (versão 18 ou superior);
  • Sólido conhecimento em Google Firebase/Firestore, incluindo paginação híbrida e lazy loading;
  • Vivência com Google Cloud Functions, Firebase Authentication e Storage;
  • Experiência com Git e boas práticas de versionamento;
  • Histórico comprovado em projetos Full-Stack profissionais (não apenas acadêmicos).

Perfil Desejado

  • Proatividade, senso de responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação técnica e capacidade de trabalho em equipe;
  • Organização, foco em resultados e comprometimento com prazos;
  • Interesse por projetos voltados à inovação e impacto social.

Condições de Trabalho

Regime: CLT

Remuneração: R$ 5.200,00 mensais

Benefícios: Vale-Transporte e Vale-Alimentação

Local de Trabalho: Presencial – Campinas-SP

Horário: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, com 1 hora de intervalo

Ambiente: Estação de trabalho completa, equipada com dois monitores e hardware adequado ao desenvolvimento Full-Stack.

description:
Gerente de Investimentos - Campinas (SP)

Sobre a oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) profissional sênior para integrar a Equipe de Investimentos, atuando com foco na prospecção, desenvolvimento e manutenção de relacionamentos com clientes de alta renda.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar prospecção ativa e desenvolvimento de novos negócios no segmento de investimentos;
  • Prestar atendimento consultivo e personalizado aos clientes, oferecendo soluções financeiras adequadas ao perfil e objetivos individuais;
  • Gerir carteira de clientes, garantindo alto nível de satisfação e fidelização;
  • Colaborar com as áreas internas para propor soluções integradas em investimentos, crédito e produtos estruturados;
  • Atuar com foco em resultados e em expansão de portfólio na região do interior paulista.

Requisitos essenciais

  • Ensino superior completo: Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada em prospecção e relacionamento com clientes alta renda;
  • Forte visão comercial e habilidade para conduzir negociações de alta complexidade;
  • Conhecimento técnico em produtos de investimento e planejamento patrimonial;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Campinas, com cobertura de clientes no interior de São Paulo;
  • CEA - Ativa.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação CFP (ou em andamento);

Benefícios que Valorizam Você:

No Daycoval, entendemos que cuidar de nossos colaboradores é essencial para promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote abrangente de benefícios, proporcionando não apenas estabilidade, mas também qualidade de vida. Nosso compromisso com o seu bem-estar vai além do profissionalismo, é uma extensão do respeito que temos por cada membro de nossa equipe.

Benefícios que Valorizam Você:

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica: Cobertura completa para cuidados médicos e odontológicos de qualidade.
  • Vale-Refeição/Alimentação
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio Creche: Apoio financeiro para conciliar trabalho e responsabilidades familiares.
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida (reforçando nosso compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho saudável)
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados (PLR): Reconhecimento financeiro pelo seu empenho e contribuição para o sucesso da empresa.
  • Programa de Participação de Resultados: Incentivo contínuo para o alcance de metas individuais e coletivas.
  • Apoio à Educação: Suporte para desenvolvimento acadêmico e profissional, investindo no seu desenvolvimento.
  • Parcerias com Desconto: Vantagens exclusivas em uma variedade de produtos e serviços por meio de parcerias estratégicas.
  • Dia Livre: Flexibilidade com um dia livre para recarregar energias e equilibrar responsabilidades.
  • Totalpass - Incentivo à Saúde: Acesso a uma ampla rede de atividades físicas, promovendo um estilo de vida ativo e saudável.
  • Ginastica Laboral: Promovendo bem-estar e motivação aos nossos colaboradores

Informações adicionais:

Oferecemos um ambiente dinâmico e cheio de oportunidades, onde todos estão imbuídos de fazer diferença nas vidas de nossos clientes. Conscientes do desafiador cenário do mercado financeiro, gostamos da intensidade que ele oferece. Vivemos um momento de transformação ativa, especialmente com a crescente influência do mundo digital em nosso setor. Estamos cheios de desafios, e convidamos você a fazer parte dessa jornada de sucesso, onde #vemserDaycoval é mais do que um convite, é um chamado para fazer história.

A Panda Logística Ltda. está agregando veículo utilitário e/ou de passeio para atuar com entrega em diversas rotas na região de Campinas em uma das maiores empresas do e-commerce do mundo.
Motoristas experientes ou pessoas habilitadas que querem iniciar nessa atividade são bem-vindos. Se você ainda não trabalhou com logística e entregas, não se preocupe, a nossa equipe dará as orientações, treinamento e suporte para que você possa ingressar conosco.
Cada motorista utiliza o seu próprio veículo. Aceitamos:Fiorino, Van, HR, Strada, Montana, Saveiro, Kangoo ou SIMILARES, desde que tenham o ano de fabricação igual ou superior a 2010.
NOSSA OPERAÇÃO
• Carregamento agendado e rápido, sem fila de espera

  • Sem Manuseio de Nota Fiscal
  • Roteirzação e registo de entregas simplificada pelo Aplicativo Próprio
  • Pagamento quinzenal
  • Incentivos extras por produtividade.
    REQUISITOS
  • Veículo até 15 anos de uso
  • CNPJ (pode ser MEI) em nome próprio
  • CNH com registro de "exerce atividade remunerada" (EAR)
  • Exame Toxicológico (após aprovação do cadastro)
    Caso necessário, daremos as orientações de como obter o MEI e EAR.
    VALORES DAS ROTAS planejadas de 8h:
  • Seg. à Sab: R$336,00 (Utilitário) + incentivo de combustível (R$0,60*km da rota)
  • Dom. e Feriados R$504,00 (Utilitário) + incentivo de combustível (R$0,60*km da rota)
    Venha fazer parte da nossa rede de motoristas parceiros, aumente sua renda e independência entregando com eficiência e segurança!!

title: Lead Accountant (Brazil) - SQM Iodine & Plant Nutrition
description:
SQM Iodine Plant Nutrition , a global mining and chemical company, has a worldwide leadership position in the markets in which we are present, which is possible thanks to the strategic location of our operations in northern Chile, from where we have access to high-value resources, in addition to our network of commercial offices that allows us to reach more than 100 countries with our products.

Every day we are inspired by our purpose: "we develop unique capabilities that transform resources into life and progress", achieving the highest quality products that generate value to strategic industries such as health, technology and food.

This is a great opportunity for talented people who can develop as a Accounting Lead for our office in Campinas, Brazil.

YOUR MISSION

Oversee and coordinate the company's administrative and financial activities, ensuring the efficient use of resources, compliance with accounting, tax, and legal obligations, and the generation of reliable information for decision-making. The objective is to guarantee financial stability, operational efficiency, and adequate support for other areas of the organization.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Bank Management

  • Receive, review, and process invoice payments.
  • Monitor cash balances based on the Company's cash flow needs.
  • Prepare bank reconciliations.

Third-Party Management

  • Keep customer and supplier master data up to date.
  • Request third-party assessments through the Compliance platform.

Credit and Commercial Control

  • Review and release customer orders in accordance with commercial risk policies.
  • Request credit line approvals from the insurer and internal managers, depending on the amount of exposure.
  • Request credit line extensions from the insurer when necessary.
  • Control and monitor customer credit lines.

Inventory Management

  • Perform the monthly closing of the inventory module.
  • Participate in the physical inventory control committees (quarterly).
  • Record adjustments resulting from physical inventory counts (when applicable).

Fixed Assets and Leases (IFRS 16)

  • Control recorded fixed assets.
  • Manage and monitor lease agreements in accordance with IFRS 16.
  • Review monthly depreciation of fixed assets and leases.

Payroll Management

  • Calculate sales commissions payable to the sales department.
  • Review payroll processed by the accounting outsourcing company.
  • Review monthly balances to be accounted for related to health, parafiscal contributions, and social benefits.

General Accounting

  • Provide support for the proper recording of accounting transactions.
  • Validate exchange rate controls on a quarterly basis.
  • Coordinate the closing and opening of accounting periods.
  • Manage accounting structures and taxes.
  • Send the monthly closing schedule to the relevant areas.

Other Routine Activities

  • Respond to and follow up on requests from the Statutory Auditor and external advisors.
  • Respond to requests from Corporate Audit.
  • Monitor and follow up on internal control.
  • Provide administrative support in response to requests from other areas, the Finance Manager, or other corporate management.
  • Analyze and communicate transfer pricing adjustments, when applicable.
  • Request supplier approvals in accordance with compliance criteria.
  • Manage expense reports on the Rydoo platform.
  • Prepare employment certificates.
  • Fill out forms for supplier registration.
  • Follow up on requirements from control entities.
  • Attend to legal procedures that apply to the company.

THE SKILLS YOU'LL NEED

  • Graduate in Accounting (Accounting Sciences) – qualification recognized in Brazil (active CRC)
  • Desirable Postgraduate degree in Finance, Taxation, or International Standards (IFRS)
  • Minimum 5 years in accounting roles (general accounting, taxes, financial reporting), preferably in medium or large companies.
  • Languages: Portuguese, English and Spanish.
  • Brazilian accounting (local standards), taxes (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL), accounting reconciliations, tax compliance, reporting to the Federal Revenue Service.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel
  • Desirable use of Odoo
  • Solid knowledge of Brazilian tax and accounting legislation: IRPJ, CSLL, ICMS, ISS, PIS/COFINS
  • Brazilian accounting standards (CPCs), IFRS, internal accounting closing and reconciliation procedures
  • Active registration with the CRC (Regional Accounting Council); IFRS course or tax MBA desirable.

WE OFFER:

  • Permanent hiring
  • Working day: Monday to Friday
  • Place of work: Initially, it will be remote work, followed by office work in Campinas, Brazil
  • The opportunity to belong and develop in a dynamic work environment and continuous learning

At SQM Iodine Plant Nutrition we are committed to the Inclusion Law (Law N°21.015), so we invite you to inform us if you require any adjustment to properly participate in our selection processes.

title: Coordenador de Logística
description:
Sobre a Vaga:

O Coordenador de Logística é responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar a aquisição de bens e serviços relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos, garantindo qualidade, entrega pontual e eficiência de custos. Essa função exige sólidos conhecimentos técnicos em logística para avaliar especificações, negociar com fornecedores e alinhar as atividades de compras às necessidades operacionais e estratégicas.

Ele/Ela se reportará ao Diretor de Compras Sub-Regional e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as fábricas e os especialistas locais em Compras de Transporte, a fim de garantir a continuidade do fornecimento e a competitividade das licitações dos fornecedores.

Principais Atribuições:

  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos para operações logísticas (transporte, armazenagem, embalagem, equipamentos e materiais).
  • Realizar análises técnicas e comerciais de propostas para garantir a conformidade com as especificações e padrões de qualidade.
  • Negociar contratos e termos comerciais, visando otimizar o custo total e o prazo de entrega.
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho dos fornecedores (SLA, qualidade, pontualidade, custo), conduzir análises de negócios e estabelecer ações corretivas conforme necessário.
  • Colaborar com as equipes técnicas e operacionais para garantir que as compras atendam aos requisitos logísticos e de produção.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de compras que reduzam riscos e aumentem a eficiência da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Manter atualizado o banco de dados de fornecedores e o mapeamento de mercado.
  • Apoiar o processo orçamentário e as premissas de tendências de mercado.
  • Gerenciar os custos logísticos, incluindo planejados versus reais, por cliente/região e como percentual da receita.
  • Acompanhar a legislação.
  • Implementar as melhores práticas; colaborar com colegas para compartilhar conhecimento e aprendizado, impulsionando a melhoria contínua.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com operações/fábricas, fornecedores e consultores para otimizar gastos por meio de projetos técnicos.
  • Estabelecer uma rotina de Rastreamento e Acompanhamento: monitorar entregas, reclamações, ocorrências e custos extras, se houver.
  • CRM (Gestão de Relacionamento com o Cliente) responsável por Incidentes/Reclamações Logísticas.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Logística, Administração de Empresas, Engenharia, Comércio Internacional ou áreas afins.
  • Mais de 10 anos de experiência em compras e gestão de suprimentos na área de logística.
  • Conhecimento técnico de processos logísticos, transporte e armazenagem.
  • Sólidas habilidades de negociação e gestão de contratos.
  • Experiência com compra/negociação de fretes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de apresentação e comunicação em espanhol e inglês.
  • Capacidade de influenciar e obter apoio em situações "de linha pontilhada".
  • Compreende as necessidades do negócio.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Node.js- Sênior.

Procuramos alguém com perfil colaborativo, boa comunicação e habilidade para se adaptar a diferentes desafios técnicos e organizacionais. Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Se você curte diversão, energia, alegria, desafios criativos e é uma pessoa organizada, resolutiva, detalhista e orientada a resultados, vem com a gente!

Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end em Node.js, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura e padrões de projeto.
  • Criar, documentar e integrar APIs RESTful de alta performance utilizando TypeScript e Express.
  • Projetar e otimizar modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL) e/ou NoSQL (MongoDB), garantindo queries performáticas e escalabilidade.
  • Utilizar ORMs como TypeORM, Sequelize ou Prisma para manipulação eficiente do banco de dados.
  • Versionar código com Git, adotando workflows (GitFlow, pull requests, code reviews) e boas práticas de controle de versão.
  • Trabalhar com Docker e docker-compose para criar ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção consistentes e reproduzíveis.
  • Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) usando Jest, Mocha ou similares.
  • Implementar mecanismos de cache (Redis, Memcached) e filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka) para melhorar performance e escalabilidade.
  • Monitorar e depurar aplicações em produção utilizando ferramentas como Node Profiler, Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus.
  • Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) para deploy automatizado em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou Kubernetes.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (front-end, DevOps, QA) em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando de planning, daily e retrospectivas.

Resquisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com Node.js e TypeScript, aplicando padrões de projeto (Factory, Repository, Dependency Injection) e estruturação modular (Clean Architecture, DDD).
  • Uso de Express (ou NestJS/Koa) para construção de APIs, dominando rotas, middlewares, tratamento de erros e validação de payload (class-validator, Joi, Celebrate).
  • Gerenciamento de pacotes com npm ou yarn, versionamento semântico (semver) e controle de dependências.
  • Testes Automatizados: domínio de frameworks como Jest ou Mocha + Chai, testes de integração (supertest) e uso de mocks/fakes.
  • Escalabilidade e Desempenho: experiência em cache (Redis), filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) e otimizações de consultas em bancos relacionais (índices, partições).
  • Performance e Debugging: uso de ferramentas como Node Profiler, Clinic.js, monitoramento com Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus/Grafana.
  • Integração Contínua e Deploy: prática com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) e deploy em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou ambientes Kubernetes.
  • Docker Avançado: criação de imagens otimizadas, multi-stage builds e configuração de docker-compose para desenvolvimento e produção.
  • Banco de Dados Relacional Avançado: MySQL ou PostgreSQL (índices, query profiling, replicação, particionamento).
  • APIs Performáticas e Seguras: experiência com GraphQL (Apollo Server), API Gateway, autenticação/autorização via OAuth2, JWT e versionamento de APIs.
  • Git Profundo: workflows GitFlow, rebase vs merge, cherry-pick e estratégias de branching para times grandes.

Habilidades:

  • Conhecimento em PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony): será considerado um diferencial entender boas práticas de desenvolvimento back-end em PHP e migrar/integrações pontuais.
  • Experiência com React (ou Next.js): habilidade para colaborar com o front-end em aplicações isomórficas ou SPA, integrando APIs e estados globais (Redux, Context API).
  • Frameworks Node.js avançados: NestJS (dependency injection, modules, providers), Koa ou Fastify para cenários de alta concorrência.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): conhecimento em Terraform ou CloudFormation para provisionamento de ambientes AWS.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: uso de ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Loki/Grafana, OpenTelemetry para logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: trabalho com Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SNS/SQS, WebSockets (Socket.io) e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Microservices: experiência em decomposição de sistemas monolíticos, deploy independente de serviços, comunicação via mensageria e API Gateway.
  • Segurança: implementação de práticas OWASP (mitigação de SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF), configuração de WAF (Cloudflare, AWS WAF) e auditoria de código.
  • Serverless: desenvolvimento e deploy de funções AWS Lambda em Node.js/TypeScript, integração com DynamoDB, S3 e triggers (SQS, API Gateway).

title: Preschool Teaching Assistant (maternity cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school's mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.

Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.

ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:

Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC's mission and values.

Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.

Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.

Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Instructional Support and Student Learning

Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.

Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.

Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.

Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.

Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.

Student Care and Learning Environment

Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.

Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).

Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.

Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.

Operational and School Support

Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.

Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.

Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.

Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.

Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.

Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed.

Professional Conduct and Growth

Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.

Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.

Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.

Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.

Additional Responsibilities

Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school's commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.

Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school.

Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.

Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.

Working Conditions

Walk on paths and rough terrain

Lifting backpacks and school materials

Other duties, as assigned.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in Pedagogy, preferred
  • Five years experience working with children, preferred
  • PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred)
  • English level required: B2 or above
  • Portuguese level required: B2 or above

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
  • Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills
  • Strong professional organization skills

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC's Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

  • Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, reviews resumes with an equity lens, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested, promoting a diverse candidate pool.

Compliance and Child Protection

  • Collaborates with outsourced providers to ensure effective monitoring of EAC's complaint channel, facilitating appropriate incident reporting, including CIPA compliance.
  • Develops and delivers appropriate compliance training to staff and ensures the fully compliance with HR related laws
  • Establishes and oversees a robust school-wide system for mandatory child protection training for all EAC staff and third-party providers (liaising with counseling staff and Leadership).
  • Stays abreast of compliance-related laws and best practices in human resources, both nationally and internationally.
  • Proactively proposes and implements policy and procedure enhancements that support ethical behavior at EAC.
  • Develops and implements safer hiring protocols, including enhanced interview processes and comprehensive background, social media, and reference checks.

Wellbeing

  • Recommends a comprehensive yearly plan, in line with the school's strategic direction, articulating meaningful developments in all aspects of staff wellness.
  • Conducts research and benchmarking exercises to ensure EAC's approach to staff wellness incorporates new ideas and initiatives.
  • Establishes mechanisms for regular staff feedback on wellness initiatives, utilizing data to inform continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates with Leadership to research and recommend new benefits for inclusion in EAC's approach to staff wellness.

Health (physical and mental/emotional)

  • Develops, promotes, and publishes a comprehensive yearly plan of offerings and events at EAC that support the health and wellbeing of all faculty & staff.
  • Develops and promotes wellbeing activities for faculty & staff, making use of local resources such as guest speakers and trainers.
  • Acts as a primary resource, providing advice and guidance to staff on personal wellbeing, and sharing awareness of internal and external resources.
  • Serves as an internal consultant for faculty and staff on personal matters, such as stress management and relationships, offering evidence-based strategies and resources to support mental health and wellbeing and foster coping mechanisms.

Other duties, as assigned.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • BA in Human Resources, Psychology, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience
  • HR policies, procedures, and best practices
  • Labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance (including CIPA)
  • HR Information Systems (HRIS)
  • Full recruitment and onboarding lifecycle
  • Compensation, benefits, and benchmarking
  • Professional development and training frameworks
  • Child protection and safeguarding protocols
  • Cultural competence and sensitivity.
  • Languages level requirement: B2 in English and C1 or above in Portuguese

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Excellent communication (verbal and written)
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities
  • High attention to detail
  • Problem-solving and conflict resolution
  • Interpersonal skills and empathy
  • Confidentiality and discretion
  • Data analysis
  • Adaptability and proactivity
  • Cultural awareness and sensitivity
  • Ability to foster an inclusive and equitable workplace culture.

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC's Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

About the role

The Brewing Specialist will lead technical and customer-driven initiatives to support innovation and renovation of Kerry's offerings in the alcoholic beverage sector, with a strong focus on beer brewing. This role is responsible for building strategic client relationships, driving adoption of Kerry technologies, and aligning with cross-functional teams to deliver excellence across LATAM.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead with technical insights and leverage customer/consumer feedback to drive innovation and renovation of Kerry's offerings.
  • Align with the RDA (Research, Development & Applications) team to ensure cross-functional excellence and consistent ways of working.
  • Own and manage the overall relationship with assigned clients, including onboarding, implementation, and increasing adoption of Kerry technologies.
  • Establish a high level of customer intimacy and build trusted, strategic relationships to drive continued value.
  • Develop and maintain customer success strategies and share best practices across commercial teams.
  • Ensure alignment with Kerry's alcoholic beverage strategy in LATAM, with a specific focus on beer brewing.
  • Travel to client sites across LATAM at least 70% of the time to support implementation, relationship building, and technical collaboration.

Qualifications and skills

  • Degree in Brewing Science, Fermentation Science, Food Science, or a related field (preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a commercial brewing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of brewing equipment, ingredients, and techniques.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance and laboratory testing procedures.
  • Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese is required.
  • Strong communication, strategic planning, and project management skills.
  • Analytical and process-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working across multiple departments in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Active team player, self-starter, and multitasker with the ability to quickly adjust priorities.
  • Passion for craft beer and innovation.
  • Skilled at developing and delivering compelling stories to clients and stakeholders.
  • Certification from recognized brewing institutions (e.g., Cicerone, IBD) (Desirable)
  • Experience with sustainable brewing practices (Desirable)
  • Knowledge of local and international beer styles (Desirable)

About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Customer Support Manager Latam
description:
The Internet of Things (IoT) is transforming our world—making it safer, more sustainable, and smarter. As a Quectel company, Acceleronix empowers customers to succeed in their IoT projects by turning innovative ideas into impactful, real-world solutions.


At Acceleronix, our customers' and employees' groundbreaking ideas drive everything we do. We take creative concepts from the drawing board to full production, delivering solutions that make a tangible difference.


Joining our team means collaborating with company leaders, and building strong relationships with colleagues who share your curiosity about connecting the unconnected. We're a team that cares deeply about our customers, values having fun, and is committed to making a positive impact in our local communities.


Role Overview


We’re seeking a proactive and experienced LATAM Customer Support Manager to build, lead, and scale our customer support function across Latin America. This role is based in Brazil Campinas and will be responsible for setting up the regional support team, defining workflows, and ensuring high service levels across technical support, commercial inquiries, and logistics coordination.


This is a hands-on leadership role requiring someone who can operate strategically while actively engaging with customers and internal teams to solve challenges, improve operations, and ensure an exceptional customer experience.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Support Operations Build the LATAM Customer Support organization from the ground up, including hiring, onboarding, and mentoring support agents. Define and implement support workflows, escalation paths, and SLAs tailored to regional needs. Oversee support for technical issues, commercial inquiries, order tracking, and logistics coordination.


Knowledge Management Develop and maintain a robust knowledge base and internal documentation. Establish best practices for capturing, updating, and sharing critical customer-facing information.


Customer Engagement & Escalation Management Serve as the escalation point for key customers and complex support cases. Foster long-term customer relationships through effective communication and issue resolution.


Collaboration & Enablement Work closely with Sales, Operations, and Product teams to streamline support handoffs and improve customer journeys. Act as the voice of the customer to influence service improvements and product enhancements.


Reporting & Continuous Improvement Track KPIs and generate insights to drive process improvements. Establish reporting cadences for internal stakeholders and continuously evaluate performance metrics.


Qualifications


Experience 5+ years in a customer support or operations leadership role, ideally in an IoT environment, telco or B2B SAAS environments. Proven experience scaling support teams and building processes from scratch. Strong understanding of technical support, customer operations, and logistics in LATAM markets.


Skills


Exceptional problem-solving and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and follow-through. Comfortable with CRM and ticketing platforms (e.G., Freshdesk, Salesforce).


Mindset: Hands-on, entrepreneurial attitude with a passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences. Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-paced environments.


Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of IoT architectures, including connectivity options (e.G., NB-IoT, LTE-M), device management, and cloud platforms.


Voice of the Customer & Innovation: Catalyst Act as an internal champion for customer needs. Translate feedback into actionable insights to influence product innovation and roadmap direction.


Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with customers, the sales team, and internal stakeholders to support customers, leveraging both Acceleronix and third-party offerings.


Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences in Portuguese, Spanish, and English.

Customer-Centric Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals.


Location Based in Brazil, Campinas.


Schedule: This position requires flexibility to work in shifts and be on-call, including weekends and holidays, to support customers across different time zones. Availability for emergency escalations and regional coordination is essential. Candidates must be prepared to adjust working hours as needed to ensure consistent service coverage and issue resolution.


Travel: The role requires frequent travel, approximately 25% of the time, both within Brazil and internationally, including multi-week business trips as needed.


This is a role at the forefront of a fast-growing tech sector, offering high-impact exposure to IoT innovation, digital transformation, and global ecosystems. You’ll join a collaborative and innovative environment within a dynamic international team, with ample opportunities for professional growth, leadership, and advancement. In addition to shaping and scaling global customer success operations, you'll benefit from competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package.


Join us at Acceleronix and be a part of shaping the future of IoT.

title: Especialista Em Ia E Business Intelligence
description:
Você é movido por dados, inovação e inteligência artificial?

Se você curte transformar informação em estratégia, desenhar soluções inteligentes e gerar impacto real nos resultados do negócio, essa vaga pode ser para você!

Venha fazer parte do time de UPXers e contribua com a nossa missão de tornar a internet um ambiente mais seguro para empresas e pessoas.

Como Especialista em IA e Business Intelligence , sua missão será liderar iniciativas que ampliem a eficiência do canal de vendas em cibersegurança por meio de automações, modelos preditivos e dashboards estratégicos — fornecendo à liderança insights precisos e acionáveis que impulsionem receita, performance e crescimento.

O desafio envolve combinar visão analítica, domínio técnico e mentalidade experimental para desenvolver soluções escaláveis e com alto impacto, sempre com uma abordagem data-driven, colaborativa e voltada a resultados.


Responsabilidades:


  • Selecionar tecnologias (LLMs, pipelines de dados, Power BI, Looker Studio) e integrá-las às plataformas de marketing, comunicação, vendas e processos de gestão estratégica;
  • Desenvolver frameworks analíticos que priorizem oportunidades de mercado, melhorem o score de leads e apoiem decisões de pricing e go-to-market;
  • Suportar os times com análise de dados, interpretando métricas e apresentando insights que orientem ações de marketing, comunicação e vendas;
  • Transformar processos manuais em fluxos autônomos de coleta, enriquecimento e ativação de dados — do first touch ao churn prevention;
  • Traduzir métricas em storytelling executivo, capacitar times internos e institucionalizar governança e qualidade dos dados;
  • Monitorar o desempenho de modelos e automações, ajustando prompts, parâmetros e consumo de recursos para garantir qualidade, velocidade e custo-benefício.


Requisitos e Perfil:


  • Graduação concluída há pelo menos 2 anos em Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de TI, Engenharia de Computação ou Ciência de Dados;
  • Conhecimento emSQL, Python e fundamentos de machine learning;
  • Experiência comprovada em Power BI ou Looker Studio (modelagem, DAX/LookML, publicação);
  • Inglês técnico;
  • Interesse por cybersecurity.


Diferenciais:


  • Projetos de IA em produção - documentação do problema, stack utilizada e impacto gerado;
  • Projetos com LLMs, LangChain, RAG ou chatbots;
  • Certificações PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-100 (Azure Machine Learning Engineer) ou Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer;
  • Vivência com dados de segurança da informação ou SaaS B2B.
  • Experiência com MLOps, incluindo CI/CD de modelos e monitoramento de drift.


Sobre a UPX:


Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.

Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDoS, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.

Contamos com unidades em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), além de uma estrutura robusta com times técnicos de elite em Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Redes, SOC, NOC e Scrubbing Centers.

Na UPX, trabalhamos todos os dias para tornar a internet mais segura, confiável e eficiente para empresas e pessoas.

title: Lead Accountant (Brazil) - Sqm Iodine & Plant Nutrition
description:
SQM Iodine Plant Nutrition , a global mining and chemical company, has a worldwide leadership position in the markets in which we are present, which is possible thanks to the strategic location of our operations in northern Chile, from where we have access to high-value resources, in addition to our network of commercial offices that allows us to reach more than 100 countries with our products.


Every day we are inspired by our purpose: “we develop unique capabilities that transform resources into life and progress” , achieving the highest quality products that generate value to strategic industries such as health, technology and food.


This is a great opportunity for talented people who can develop as a Accounting Lead for our office in Campinas, Brazil.


YOUR MISSION

Oversee and coordinate the company's administrative and financial activities, ensuring the efficient use of resources, compliance with accounting, tax, and legal obligations, and the generation of reliable information for decision-making. The objective is to guarantee financial stability, operational efficiency, and adequate support for other areas of the organization.


WHAT YOU’LL DO


Bank Management

  • Receive, review, and process invoice payments.
  • Monitor cash balances based on the Company's cash flow needs.
  • Prepare bank reconciliations.


Third-Party Management

  • Keep customer and supplier master data up to date.
  • Request third-party assessments through the Compliance platform.


Credit and Commercial Control

  • Review and release customer orders in accordance with commercial risk policies.
  • Request credit line approvals from the insurer and internal managers, depending on the amount of exposure.
  • Request credit line extensions from the insurer when necessary.
  • Control and monitor customer credit lines.


Inventory Management

  • Perform the monthly closing of the inventory module.
  • Participate in the physical inventory control committees (quarterly).
  • Record adjustments resulting from physical inventory counts (when applicable).


Fixed Assets and Leases (IFRS 16)

  • Control recorded fixed assets.
  • Manage and monitor lease agreements in accordance with IFRS 16.
  • Review monthly depreciation of fixed assets and leases.


Payroll Management

  • Calculate sales commissions payable to the sales department.
  • Review payroll processed by the accounting outsourcing company.
  • Review monthly balances to be accounted for related to health, parafiscal contributions, and social benefits.


General Accounting

  • Provide support for the proper recording of accounting transactions.
  • Validate exchange rate controls on a quarterly basis.
  • Coordinate the closing and opening of accounting periods.
  • Manage accounting structures and taxes.
  • Send the monthly closing schedule to the relevant areas.


Other Routine Activities

  • Respond to and follow up on requests from the Statutory Auditor and external advisors.
  • Respond to requests from Corporate Audit.
  • Monitor and follow up on internal control.
  • Provide administrative support in response to requests from other areas, the Finance Manager, or other corporate management.
  • Analyze and communicate transfer pricing adjustments, when applicable.
  • Request supplier approvals in accordance with compliance criteria.
  • Manage expense reports on the Rydoo platform.
  • Prepare employment certificates.
  • Fill out forms for supplier registration.
  • Follow up on requirements from control entities.
  • Attend to legal procedures that apply to the company.


THE SKILLS YOU’LL NEED

  • Graduate in Accounting (Accounting Sciences) – qualification recognized in Brazil (active CRC)
  • Desirable Postgraduate degree in Finance, Taxation, or International Standards (IFRS)
  • Minimum 5 years in accounting roles (general accounting, taxes, financial reporting), preferably in medium or large companies.
  • Languages: Portuguese, English and Spanish.
  • Brazilian accounting (local standards), taxes (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL), accounting reconciliations, tax compliance, reporting to the Federal Revenue Service.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel
  • Desirable use of Odoo
  • Solid knowledge of Brazilian tax and accounting legislation: IRPJ, CSLL, ICMS, ISS, PIS/COFINS
  • Brazilian accounting standards (CPCs), IFRS, internal accounting closing and reconciliation procedures
  • Active registration with the CRC (Regional Accounting Council);
    IFRS course or tax MBA desirable.


WE OFFER:

  • Permanent hiring
  • Working day: Monday to Friday
  • Place of work: Initially, it will be remote work, followed by office work in Campinas, Brazil
  • The opportunity to belong and develop in a dynamic work environment and continuous learning


At SQM Iodine Plant Nutrition we are committed to the Inclusion Law (Law N°21.015) , so we invite you to inform us if you require any adjustment to properly participate in our selection processes.

title: On-Site It Support Engineer
description:
Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.

Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance, ensuring uptime and reliability.

Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.

Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.

Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.

Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.

Expected Results

Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.

Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.

Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.

Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.

Qualifications & Skills

Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles.

Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals.

Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.

Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks.

Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.

Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.

Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.
